title: OpenCode HTTP Session Status Shape Reader Direct Verification
summary: The newly implemented read-only MCP tool forgepilot_get_opencode_http_session_status_shape became callable from the ChatGPT tool surface and was directly invoked. It authenticated to the already-running local OpenCode HTTP server, read /session/status only, and returned sessionStatusReachable=true, sessionStatusHttpStatus=200, content-type application/json, topLevelType=object, topLevelEntryCount=0, topLevelKeys=[], sessionLikeEntryCount=0, sessionLikeIds=[], and observedEntryShapes=[]. This confirms the current /session/status shape is an empty object when no session-like entries are visible through this endpoint.
caveats: An earlier FP-MCP-245 checkpoint recorded schema-surface pending because the new tool was present in source and dist but not yet surfaced in this ChatGPT session; this follow-up supersedes that caveat for direct tool availability.

The observed empty object means no session-like entries were visible at the time of observation; it does not prove OpenCode has no historical sessions or that all UI state is exposed through /session/status.
No OpenCode session was created, no prompt was sent, no message contents were read, and /api/session/{sessionID}/wait was not called.
boundaries: This checkpoint records direct read-only verification only.
